title: Raft: how a cluster picks one leader and replicates a log without losing data
summary: Terms, leaders, AppendEntries, the commit index, joint consensus, pre-vote, snapshots — Raft as a senior engineer actually needs to operate it.
crux: How three to seven machines, any of which can crash or be partitioned at any time, agree on exactly one ordered log of changes.
keytakeaway: Raft = one leader per term + ordered log + majority quorum for commits and elections. Safety from quorum overlap. Production needs pre-vote, joint consensus, learners, snapshots, lease reads.
